description: This PHP source file defines a class 'sysinfo' that provides system information retrieval methods specific to SunOS operating systems, including kernel info, hostname, IP address, uptime, load averages, CPU info, network stats, memory, filesystems, and distribution details.

classes.name: sysinfo
classes.description: A class providing methods to gather system information on SunOS systems, including kernel details, hostname, IP address, uptime, load averages, CPU info, network statistics, memory, filesystems, and distribution info.

methods.name: kstat
methods.description: Executes the 'kstat' command to retrieve kernel statistics for a given key.

methods.name: vhostname
methods.description: Returns the server's hostname from environment variables.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Retrieves the canonical hostname using 'uname' and reverse DNS lookup.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Gets the IP address associated with the hostname.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Returns the operating system name and version.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Calculates system uptime based on boot time kernel statistic.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of logged-in users.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Retrieves system load averages for 1, 5, and 15 minutes.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU model, speed, cache, and core count information.

methods.name: pci
methods.description: Placeholder for PCI device info (not implemented).

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Placeholder for IDE device info (not implemented).

methods.name: scsi
methods.description: Placeholder for SCSI device info (not implemented).

methods.name: usb
methods.description: Placeholder for USB device info (not implemented).

methods.name: network
methods.description: Retrieves network interface statistics including bytes, packets, errors, and drops.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Gathers memory and swap usage statistics.

methods.name: filesystems
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem usage and mount points.

methods.name: distroicon
methods.description: Returns the icon filename for SunOS.
